topic: Issue of shares at a discount
question: Explain the restrictions on issue of shares at a discount under the Companies Act, 2013, and the exceptions to them.
sources: Companies Act, 2013 - section 53 prohibition on issue of shares at discount
Companies Act, 2013 - section 54 sweat equity shares

points.label: General prohibition
points.description: A company cannot issue shares at a discount, i.e. for less than their nominal value.

points.label: Exception: sweat equity
points.description: Sweat equity shares issued under section 54 to directors or employees may be issued at a discount.

points.label: Exception: conversion of debt
points.description: Shares may be issued at a discount to creditors when their debt is converted into shares under a statutory resolution plan or a debt restructuring scheme following RBI guidelines.
points.basis: Companies Act, 2013, section 53, exception for conversion of debt under RBI-guided schemes

points.label: Consequences
points.description: Shares issued at a discount in breach of the section are void; the company and every officer in default are liable to a penalty, and the company must refund the money received with interest.
points.basis: Companies Act, 2013, section 53, consequences of contravention
